    VECTOR(matrix_x)
    VECTOR(matrix_y)
    VECTOR(matrix_z)

    GENERIC(ASS_Font *, font)
    GENERIC(double, size)
    GENERIC(int, face_index)

    GENERIC(int, glyph_index)
    GENERIC(int, bold)
    GENERIC(int, italic)

START(border, border_hash_key)

    GENERIC(int, scale_ord_x)
    GENERIC(int, scale_ord_y)

END(BorderHashKey)

// describes post-combining effects
START(filter, filter_desc)
    GENERIC(int, flags)
    GENERIC(int, be)
    GENERIC(int, blur)
    VECTOR(shadow)
END(FilterDesc)

    GENERIC(Bitmap *, bm)
    GENERIC(Bitmap *, bm_o)
    VECTOR(pos)
    VECTOR(pos_o)
END(BitmapRef)

#undef GENERIC
